_note: Red Alert detection thresholds. All values are configurable — change here, not in source code. Capitalized comment keys explain each threshold.

CATEGORY_A_SALESPERSON._note: Performance alerts for individual territory managers and teams. Requires a target to be present (Guard 7).
CATEGORY_A_SALESPERSON.A1_THRESHOLD_NOTE: Cumulative OB / pro-rated-to-date target below this % triggers A1. 35% means running at half-speed vs the seasonal plan.
CATEGORY_A_SALESPERSON.A1_SUSTAINED_NOTE: Number of consecutive complete months the achievement must stay below A1_THRESHOLD_PCT before the alert fires.
CATEGORY_A_SALESPERSON.A2_NOTE: A2 fires on a single complete month with ordered_amount = 0 when plan_amount > 0. No separate threshold needed.
CATEGORY_A_SALESPERSON.A3_THRESHOLD_NOTE: Target-weighted team secondary achievement below this % triggers A3.
CATEGORY_A_SALESPERSON.A3_SUSTAINED_NOTE: Number of consecutive complete months the team achievement must stay below A3_THRESHOLD_PCT.

CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS._note: Alerts on individual customer / retailer behaviour. Like-months comparison only (Guard 2).
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B1_NOTE: Real value growth (= nominal growth minus MRP-index increase) below this % triggers B1.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B2_NOTE: Nominal like-month value decline >= this % triggers B2.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B2_SUSTAINED_NOTE: B2 requires decline in the current period vs prior AND in the prior period vs prior-prior.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B3_NOTE: B3 fires when a customer has zero purchase now and non-zero in the prior comparable period. Single occurrence, no threshold.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B4_SEGMENT_FLOOR_NOTE: B4 requires the prior-period segment value to be at least this amount (₹5 L) before a segment dropout is flagged.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B4_NOTE: B4 fires when a segment bought in the prior period has zero purchase now.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B5_BREADTH_DROP_FLOOR_NOTE: Distinct item codes must drop by at least this % from prior period.
CATEGORY_B_DEALERS_RETAILERS.B5_PRIOR_CODE_FLOOR_NOTE: B5 only fires when the customer held >= this many distinct codes in the prior period.

CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT._note: Territory, segment, and operational health alerts.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C1_CONCENTRATION_NOTE: A customer carrying >= this share of a state's territory value triggers concentration check.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C1_DECLINE_NOTE: The concentrated customer must decline >= this % for C1 to fire.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C2_STATE_DECLINE_NOTE: State territory value down >= this % triggers C2.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C2_SUSTAINED_NOTE: C2 requires decline in the current period AND the prior period.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C3_NOTE: A segment >= this many percentage points below the company rate (adjusted for its own seasonal position) triggers C3.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C4_NOTE: Gross contribution down >= this % while volume is up triggers C4. Only fires where factory cost (bom_cost) exists in margin_fact.
CATEGORY_C_TERRITORY_SEGMENT.C5_NOTE: A member whose working sheet has not been successfully read for >= this many days triggers C5.

MATERIALITY_FLOORS._note: Minimum prior-period value for a customer to be considered for B-category alerts.
MATERIALITY_FLOORS.DISTRIBUTOR_NOTE: ₹25 L prior-year territory value floor for distributor-level B alerts.
MATERIALITY_FLOORS.DIRECT_DEALER_NOTE: ₹15 L prior-year territory value floor for direct-dealer-level B alerts.
MATERIALITY_FLOORS.RETAILER_NOTE: ₹2 L prior-year secondary value floor for retailer-level B alerts.

GUARD_THRESHOLDS.PARTIAL_TENURE_NOTE: Members with fewer than this many working days are excluded from A-category performance alerts (Guard 8).
